item.title: Almost 5,000 square feet! One acre in Missouri. $209,000
item.description: This is a big house with almost 5,000 square feet! The house was built in 1940. It is located on 1.1 acres in Kirksville, Missouri. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, baseboards, crown moulding, built-in china cabinet, updated kitchen, wainscoting and coffered ceiling. There is a large basement, attic and a two car garage. Three bedrooms, four bathrooms and 4,888 square feet. $209,000 Contact Greg Freeman with Century 21 Team Elite: 660-358-4003 From the Zillow listing: Spaci

item.title: South Carolina’s most expensive old house listing! Drayton House, C. 1885. $28,000,000
item.description: Welcome to South Carolina’s most expensive old house listing! Known as Drayton House, it was built in 1885. It is located on .31 acre in Charleston, South Carolina. The house features a glass elevator, stunning bar, walk-in refrigerator, intricate millwork, hidden commercial kitchen, luxury spa features, porches overlooking the harbor and an amazing kitchen! Six bedrooms, ten bathrooms and 11,367 square feet. $28,000,000 From the Zillow listing: Charleston’s storied Victorian masterpiece reimagi

item.title: Nice details inside! Circa 1948 in North Carolina. $278,000
item.description: This house has pretty details inside! I love the coffered ceiling! The house was built in 1948. It is located on .38 acre in Enfield, North Carolina. The house features a covered side porch, wood floors, crown moulding, chair rails, wainscoting, wide baseboards, updated kitchen and a coffered ceiling. There is a spacious backyard with patio, deck and a detached storage shed. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,498 square feet. $278,000 Contact Sterling Grimes with Foote Real Estate: 252-813-8216

item.title: Beautiful mountain view! Circa 1899 in North Carolina. $115,000
item.description: Pretty views from this house! It needs some work, but it has loads of potential! The house was built in 1899. It is located on .65 acre in Burnsville, North Carolina. The house was a schoolhouse at some point in its history. It features a covered front porch, wood floors, baseboards and a spacious kitchen. item.title: Pretty area! C. 1900. Two acres in Virginia. $244,000
item.description: This house is in a pretty area of Virginia! I love the setting! The house was built in 1900. It is located on two acres in Stuart, Virginia. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, baseboards, bead board and wide plank wood floors upstairs. There is a detached one car garage. The house has an updated kitchen. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,739 square feet. $244,000 Contact Johnny Lambert with United Country Lambert Realty: 276-952-5502 From the Zillow listing: This 3-bedroom

item.title: South Dakota’s most expensive old house listing! C. 1926. $5,700,000
item.description: Welcome to South Dakota’s most expensive old house listing! Love the landscaping. The house was built in 1926. It is located on 2.88 acres in Sioux Falls, South Dakota. The house features a circular drive, fountain, crown moulding, wood floors, wide baseboards, paneled wainscoting, built-in bookshelves, arched entryway, sunroom, spacious kitchen and updated bathrooms. item.title: Island time! A private island in New Hampshire. $2,499,000
item.description: Island time! How about a private island! The house was built in 1930. It is located on .4 acre in Holderness, New Hampshire. The island is situated in Squam Lake. This seasonal cottage features an enclosed porch, a covered front porch, a 1990’s updated kitchen and wood floors. Power is supplied through a generator. Two bedrooms, three bathrooms and 1,560 square feet. $2,499,000 Contact Brie Stephens with Compass New England: 603-403-5944 From the Zillow listing: Imagine summer days spent picking

item.title: Love stone houses! Circa 1800 in New Jersey. $315,000
item.description: I love stone houses! The Musconetcong River is across the road from the house. The home was built in 1800. It is located in the village of Finesville, New Jersey. The house features a stone exterior, wood plank wood floors, chair rails, wide baseboards, updated kitchen, updated bathrooms and original millwork. The house isn’t far from the Delaware River. One bedroom and two bathrooms. $315,000 Contact Barbara Groogan with Coldwell Banker Hearthside: 908-996-7151 From the Zillow listing: A little

item.title: Pretty setting! Seven acres in North Carolina. Has outbuildings! $399,900
item.description: This house has a pretty setting! Love the pond and there are outbuildings! The house was built in 1939. It is located on seven acres in Sparta, North Carolina. The house features a large covered porch, wood floors, knotty pine, exposed brick and baseboards. The pictures aren’t the greatest. The property has a koi pond, dock, stream, a large barn and other outbuildings. Three bedrooms, three bathrooms and 1,980 square feet. $399,900 Contact Darlene Wyatt with Mountain Dreams Realty: 336-372-1622

item.title: That library! I need it! C. 1925 in Virginia. $235,000
item.description: Take a look at that library! That is pretty amazing! I remember this house because of that library! Looks like the seller updated bathrooms, kitchen, electrical and HVAC. Unfortunately, some of the flooring has been updated. But that library! The house was built in 1925. It is located on .51 acre in Roanoke, Virginia.
